diagnostics.message: M92 is not a standard Fanuc code; it is taken to be machine-specific and ignored (no movement). If it moves the machine, list it in the machine file's ignore_codes or expect the drawing to differ. Not reported again.

assumed G21 (mm): the program has not selected this mode yet. A Fanuc control keeps the units that were active when it was switched off, so the machine may be in inches. Add G21 (mm) near the start of the program to make it explicit.
